== Summary ==
Players Committee legacy virtual-card slip PDF ''Virtual Block 7: Ultimate Conflict'' (cover: official text as of 3 June 2011). This is the official <code>VirtualBlock7_3.pdf</code> that the Committee hosted at res.starwarsccg.org and that is cited on [[Virtual Block 7]]. Throdo also attached this exact file (same SHA-1) to his Players Committee forum post of 10 May 2022, "Original 17 VSet PDFs & Pre-Reset Block PDFs" (post 1376415, forum attachment id 16723).

* '''Date:''' 3 June 2011 (official text date on the cover)
* '''Pages:''' 7

== Source ==
[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf VirtualBlock7_3.pdf], Star Wars CCG Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174522/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive]. The archived copy is byte-identical to this file (the SHA-1 of the archived payload matches).
